HEEWON STYLE — a premium KOREAN WEBTOON / MANHWA splash illustration of a group, lit with cinematic tenebrism. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). FORMAL FAMILY PORTRAIT, everyone facing the camera, faces readable, eye-level. DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair). It must read as an INKED DRAWING: visible line strokes everywhere — bold tapered contour lines around every figure, drawn fold lines in the silk and armour, hair drawn as inked strands, a little cross-hatching and line shading in the shadows — then flat cel-shading in two or three tones per colour, no airbrushed gradients. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly, NOT a 3D render, no skin pores or photographic texture. ONLY THESE NINE PEOPLE in the frame. THE SILLA ROYAL FAMILY — A BIG FAMILY PHOTO. In the centre, seated: OLD KING JINPYUNG (not on the sheet: a tired old man with a long white beard, kind heavy-lidded eyes, the tall Silla gold crown with tree-and-antler uprights and jade pendants, crimson robe). Around him, from the sheet: Princess Dukman standing at his right shoulder, chin up, eyes drifting upward as if counting stars; Princess Sungman at his left shoulder, arms folded, stern; Princess Chunmyung seated on the step beside him, gentle, with her husband KIM YONGSU (not on the sheet: a middle-aged noble with a thin moustache, purple robe, small black feather cap) standing behind her with a hand on her shoulder; their son Chunchu at the right edge, one eyebrow raised, sly half-smile; his young wife Munhee beside him holding a three-year-old girl, Gotaso, who waves at the camera; and the little boy Bupmin in front, fidgeting and tugging the king's sleeve. A warm family charge: a stifled laugh, a rolled eye, a proud grandfather. Field behind: flat deep red-black. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): 1st face from the LEFT of the sheet = PRINCESS DUKMAN; 2nd face from the LEFT of the sheet = PRINCESS SUNGMAN; 3rd face from the LEFT of the sheet = PRINCESS CHUNMYUNG; 4th face from the LEFT of the sheet = KIM CHUNCHU; 5th face from the LEFT of the sheet = MUNHEE; 6th face from the LEFT of the sheet = BUPMIN. PRINCESS DUKMAN — Look: Pale oval face, dark calm eyes; black hair in a full coiled updo; when crowned, the gold Silla tree-and-antler crown hung with jade gogok. Dress: Crimson court robe with gold phoenix brocade, blue embroidered cape-collar, a red ribbon bow at the chest. Now: Princess Deokman (stage portrait): no crown, hair pinned with her binyeo. Colour #E8552B. | PRINCESS SUNGMAN Colour #9d7bd0. | PRINCESS CHUNMYUNG Colour #d8a0e8. | KIM CHUNCHU — Look: Slim and elegant; shoulder-length loose black hair parted in the middle; amused eyes, small knowing smile. Dress: Magenta-crimson silk po with a charcoal sash, dark layered collar. Silk even on campaign. Now: Young hwarang (stage portrait): clean-shaven, no moustache, no goatee, a young man's face; eager. Colour #D8258C. | MUNHEE Colour #E07FA8. | BUPMIN — Look: Square jaw, goatee and moustache, confident grin; arms folded when he is pleased with himself. Dress: As king: crimson robe with gold dragon embroidery, blue shoulder pieces, gold Silla crown. Earlier: prince/hwarang stage portraits. Colour #C41E3A. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (dark manhwa tenebrism, like a dramatic manhwa splash page): a MINIMAL MONOTONE background — one flat dark field in a single hue (the characters' colour deepened almost to black), at most a few soft wisps of smoke in that same hue; no set, no architecture, no landscape, no furniture, no props beyond what the characters hold or sit on; ONE hard directional light from the side or below carves the faces and silk in high contrast, the far side of each figure falling off into black shadow, a thin edge of the same light along the silhouettes; deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, strong cast shadows across the faces. Each person's colour is the colour of the light and the shadow-tint on them — never a glow aura or halo. BLOCKING, BODY LANGUAGE AND FACIAL EXPRESSIONS show the relationship at a glance. Faces and clothes from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. One of each person, never cloned. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark.
